items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: did you leave anything out there? "A couple of places could have been a little bit better, b…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问：你有没有保留实力？“有几个地方本可以更好一点，但我觉得每次排位赛后大家都这么说。所以总的来说，我对这个成绩挺满意的。说实话，有点惊讶没能更接近一点，但有时候就是这样。所以我觉得这个周末总的来说，我对赛车的表现满意多了，也感觉更有信心了，即使成绩不一定反映出来。”（这部分采访我没录到，抱歉！）
items.summary: Q: did you leave anything out there? "A couple of places could have been a little bit better, but I mean, I feel like everyone says that after every qualifying lap. So overall, I was pretty happy with it. A little bit surprised to not be a bit closer, if I'm honest but that's how it goes sometimes. So I think this weekend in general, I've been a lot happier with what the car's been doing and I just felt a lot more confident, even if the results haven't necessarily translated that." (I missed recording this part of the interview, sorry!)

items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: Are you in a race with Ferrari or is it still close with the top 3? "It's tough to know. I t…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问：你们是在和Ferrari竞争，还是和前三名仍然很接近？“很难说。我觉得我们在那场冲刺赛的后半段看起来不太好，对我们俩来说都是。有点意外，因为昨天我们的单圈速度，我们认为，如果我们俩都能跑出更好的圈速，我们本可以上第一排。今天没有这个速度有点意外，但希望我们能排位赛表现好，然后明天能坚持得更好一些。”
items.summary: Q: Are you in a race with Ferrari or is it still close with the top 3? "It's tough to know. I think we didn't look great especially in the second half of that sprint, for the both of us. A little bit surprising because our one lap pace yesterday we thought, with some slightly better laps for both of us, we could've been on the front row. A little bit surprising to not have the pace today but hopefully we can qualify well and then hang on a bit better tomorrow."
items.summary_zh: 问：你们是在和Ferrari竞争，还是和前三名仍然很接近？“很难说。我觉得我们在那场冲刺赛的后半段看起来不太好，对我们俩来说都是。有点意外，因为昨天我们的单圈速度，我们认为，如果我们俩都能跑出更好的圈速，我们本可以上第一排。今天没有这个速度有点意外，但希望我们能排位赛表现好，然后明天能坚持得更好一些。”

items.title: X repost from @laurogeitabat: Q: Were you disappointed that maybe a little bit more pace didn't come out of the car? "A littl…
items.title_zh: X 转帖 @laurogeitabat：问：你是否对赛车没有展现出更多速度感到失望？“有一点，是的。我觉得只是软胎那一圈不够好。感觉今年经常是这样，你换上软胎，但平衡不如中性胎时那么好。但与我今早练习时相比，开心多了。我们做了一些调整，我满意多了，所以我认为这是积极的一面，是今早以来的进步。显然差距非常接近，我觉得如果圈速更好，也许我们能拿到杆位，但我正在学习和进步。这才是最重要的。”
items.summary: Q: Were you disappointed that maybe a little bit more pace didn't come out of the car? "A little bit, yeah. I think just the soft lap wasn't quite as good. I feel like it's often the case this year, that you put the soft tyre on and it's not quite as nice as the balance you have on the medium. But compared to where I was this morning in practice, much happier. We changed a few things and I was a lot happier so I think that's the positive, the progress from this morning. Yeah obviously it was pretty close and I feel like with a better lap, maybe we could've had pole but I'm learning and improving. That's the most important thing."
items.summary_zh: 问：你是否对赛车没有展现出更多速度感到失望？“有一点，是的。我觉得只是软胎那一圈不够好。感觉今年经常是这样，你换上软胎，但平衡不如中性胎时那么好。但与我今早练习时相比，开心多了。我们做了一些调整，我满意多了，所以我认为这是积极的一面，是今早以来的进步。显然差距非常接近，我觉得如果圈速更好，也许我们能拿到杆位，但我正在学习和进步。这才是最重要的。”
